chunks: As for what Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Abu Ja'far, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Abd Allah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
One may eat from all of the hady, whether it is guaranteed or not guaranteed.

key_terms.الْهَدْيِ: the sacrificial offering sent for hajj rites
key_terms.غَيْرَ مَضْمُونٍ: not guaranteed; an offering without such liability
key_terms.كُلِّهِ: all of it; denotes general applicability
key_terms.مَضْمُونًا: guaranteed; an offering for which liability or replacement is established
key_terms.يُؤْكَلُ: it may be eaten; indicates permissibility of consuming from the offering

ai.seo_question: Can one eat from the hady if it is a guaranteed sacrificial offering?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hady offered in hajj. It states that eating from the sacrificial offering is permitted in all cases, whether the offering is classified as guaranteed or non-guaranteed.
